title: Hermetic git env: scrub GIT_* in every git-spawning helper
summary: Makes the osf test suite hermetic against the git environment a pre-push hook exports. A new `scrub_locating_git_env` helper removes only the repository-locating `GIT_*` variables (leaving `GIT_INDEX_FILE` and the rest alone); `scrub_with_index` now delegates to it, `merge_base` scrubs before running git, and moon's `strip_inherited_moon_vars` scrubs locating vars so nested moon finds its own repository. Every test helper that shells out to git — in assets, changeset, clean_copy, config, checkpoint, builder, git and the assets_publish integration test — now scrubs first and runs `git init` from inside the target directory. Two new ignored tests run the whole lib and integration suites under a sentinel `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_WORK_TREE`/`GIT_INDEX_FILE` and assert the sentinel's git directory is byte-identical afterwards.

nodes.label: git_env_hermetic.rs
nodes.subtitle: sentinel GIT_DIR harness
nodes.summary: Builds a sentinel repository, snapshots every file under its git directory, runs a nested cargo test with GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE/GIT_INDEX_FILE pointed at it, then asserts the snapshot is unchanged and no `[user]` section or `core.bare` change appeared. Two new ignored tests widen this from the config module to the whole lib and integration suites.

nodes.label: nested cargo test
nodes.subtitle: -p osf --lib / --tests
nodes.summary: The child cargo invocation the hermeticity tests start, now also given GIT_INDEX_FILE so the sentinel's index is in play as well as its GIT_DIR and work tree.

nodes.label: unit test git helpers
nodes.summary: The per-module helpers in builder, changeset_tests, checkpoint, clean_copy, config and git.rs that shell out to git. Each now scrubs the inherited GIT_* variables before running, and `git init` runs with its working directory set to the target dir so a process-wide cwd change by another test cannot redirect it.

nodes.label: assets_publish.rs
nodes.summary: The bare-remote fixture and its `commits_on` / `file_at` helpers now scrub the git environment through the public `osf::scrub_git_env` before running git init, log and show.

nodes.label: scrub_locating_git_env
nodes.subtitle: fn(&mut Command)
nodes.summary: New crate-visible helper that removes only the repository-locating GIT_* variables from a child command, deliberately leaving GIT_INDEX_FILE and everything else inherited. It is the narrow counterpart to the full scrub, for children that run git themselves.

nodes.label: scrub_with_index
nodes.subtitle: fn(&mut Command, &Path, Option<OsString>)
nodes.summary: The full scrub used by `scrub_git_env_for_dir`. Its locating-variable loop is now a call to `scrub_locating_git_env`; the GIT_INDEX_FILE containment check is unchanged.

nodes.label: merge_base
nodes.subtitle: fn(&Path, &str, &str)
nodes.summary: Now scrubs the git environment for the target directory before running `git merge-base`, so the answer comes from that repository rather than a caller's GIT_DIR.

nodes.label: strip_inherited_moon_vars
nodes.subtitle: fn(&mut Command)
nodes.summary: Already removed every inherited MOON_* variable; now also calls `scrub_locating_git_env`, so a nested moon that runs git finds the repository from its working directory instead of the outer task's GIT_DIR.

nodes.label: assets run_git
nodes.subtitle: fn(&Path, &[&str])
nodes.summary: The production git runner behind asset publishing now scrubs the git environment for its directory before spawning git.

nodes.label: git
nodes.summary: The git CLI. Resolves which repository to act on from GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE and the working directory, which is exactly what the scrub is about.

nodes.label: moon
nodes.summary: The moon task runner, which runs git itself and must find the workspace's repository from its working directory.

nodes.label: sentinel .git
